decisions.reason: The broadcast-ready finish standard does not change the existing Audio DB 18 mixing requirement or establish a new audio-specific value.
The source imposes an overall final-quality standard but does not change the required visual-generation method or realism acceptance criteria.
Broadcast-ready quality does not alter the existing cut strategy or add a specific retention-editing rule.
The source does not change responsibility for scripts, visual materials, voiceover, or client-supplied inputs.
The overall technical-finish standard does not modify the independently established viral creative-style requirement.
The source does not change the selected reference-led creative direction or its relationship to the reference video.
The source does not change the pilot quantity, duration, formats, or follow-on order condition; its delivery deadline is project-management state rather than a package requirement.
The request for broadcast-ready final quality neither cancels nor modifies the preview artifact and approval workflow.
The source does not establish a new lip-sync or facial-performance value beyond the existing accuracy and naturalness requirements.
The source does not change which products must appear or how their product imagery is sourced.
The broadcast-ready finish requirement does not modify actor nationality or gender preferences.
The source does not change the Hindi-only script and preview-language requirements.
